title: chase_the_ball
about: Every step: how fast the car moves toward the ball. The same as the built-in velocity_player_to_ball.

title: flip_back_height
about: When the car gets its flip back above 100 units: its height x 0.25.

title: aerial_air_time
about: On a touch: the smaller of the time in the air (a variable, up to 1.75 s) and the ball's height. The same as aerial_touch_airtime.

title: kickoff_race
about: Every step of a kickoff: 1 while nearer the ball than every opponent, else -0.8. The same as kickoff_nearest.

terms.value: if(has_opp and dist(me.pos, ball.pos) < min_opps(dist(it.pos, ball.pos)), 1, -0.8)

title: keep_apart
about: Every step: a charge for each teammate nearer than 1000 units (-1 on top of it).

terms.value: sum_mates(if(not it.demoed and dist(me.pos, it.pos) < 1000, -(1 - dist(me.pos, it.pos) / 1000), 0))

title: wall_ready
about: On a wall above 200 with the ball just above and over 50 boost: 1 a step, 4 with a touch. The same as wall_positioning.

terms.when: me.on_ground and me.z > 200 and ball.z > me.z and dist(ball.pos, me.pos) < 463.75 and me.boost > 50

title: fast_goal
about: On a goal: the ball's speed the step before (x 1.75 when it was off the floor). The same as goal_speed_and_placement.

title: land_well
about: Falling above 250 units: how well the nose follows the flight and the roof points up. The same as landing_recovery.

title: touch_then_goal
about: On a goal: 1 when the car touched the ball in the 3 seconds before (a sequence).

title: reset_then_shot
about: A shot within 2 seconds of a flip reset (a sequence).

title: long_air_dribble
about: A touch in the air after at least 1 second in the air, more for each touch in a row without landing (a counter), at most 5 an episode.
